title: 第一章 星冕落尘紫影初临第二章 炽冰微光一眼倾心
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 晨间的鎏金晨光穿透轻薄的云层，温柔倾泻而下，完整铺满整座琉光星冕综合学园。

这座伫立在人界繁华腹地的顶级综合学府，从来都不止是承载万千学子青春课业的普通校园。它是隐匿在人间烟火深处的圣域据点，是星界六大王族蛰伏人界的庇护之地，是封印浩劫余孽、隔绝暗影侵蚀的最后一道人界屏障。整座学园的建筑格局承袭星界古雅制式，融合现代学府的利落大气，层层楼宇错落排布，奶白鎏金渐变的石材墙体在晨光里流淌着细碎的星芒纹路，那些隐刻在砖石缝隙、廊柱墙面的古老守护咒印，历经数百年时光沉淀，平日里静默无声，唯有晨昏微光洒落之时，才会悄然亮起极淡的圣洁光晕，默默守护着整片学园的安宁。

学园主干道宽阔坦荡，笔直延伸向校园深处，道路两侧整齐林立着独属于星冕学园的星纹梧桐。这是仅受星界灵气滋养方能存活的珍稀灵木，挺拔的树干干净笔直，层层叠叠的翠绿枝叶边缘萦绕着淡淡的金色微光，晨风吹拂而过，满树枝叶轻轻摇曳，沙沙声响温柔绵长，筛落满地斑驳错落的光影。林间栖息的飞鸟振翅轻鸣，清脆婉转的啼声穿透薄雾，与教学楼里细碎的书页翻动声、少年少女轻快的说笑声、操场远处零星的脚步声相融交织，勾勒出青春校园最鲜活、最安稳、最治愈的日常图景。
空气湿润清新，裹挟着草木的清香与晨间微凉的风，漫过校园的每一寸角落，温柔拂过每一扇敞开的窗棂。世间烟火温柔，岁月静好，所有人都沉浸在这份安稳的日常里，无人知晓，一场足以撕碎一切平和、颠覆整座校园秩序的黑暗浩劫，正从学园后山的禁忌密林深处，悄然苏醒，步步逼近。
早读预备铃声尚未响起，高二（1）班的教室已然暖意融融、座无虚席。

作为全校重点标杆班级，高二（1）班坐落于教学楼三楼东侧，坐拥绝佳采光，通透的落地窗尽数敞开，晨间清风裹挟着室外的草木气息涌入教室，撩动课桌上平铺的课本纸页，轻轻吹动少年少女额前柔软的碎发，为整洁明亮的教室添满勃勃生机。教室内窗明几净，地面一尘不染，桌椅排列得整整齐齐，每一张桌面都收拾得干净利落，课本、教辅、笔记本、笔袋有序摆放，规整又治愈。黑板擦拭得光洁透亮，边角的绿植盆栽枝叶繁茂，细碎绿意点缀在教室各处，温柔冲淡了课业的紧绷感，让整间教室松弛又温暖。
此刻的教室氛围松弛而热闹，没有早读的紧绷，也没有课间的喧闹。同学们三三两两凑成松散的小团体，低声闲谈着周末的日常趣事，有人分享街头甜品店的新品滋味，有人热议热播的剧集动漫，有人无奈吐槽堆积如山的周末作业，少年少女轻快温柔的笑语交织在一起，鲜活又治愈；另有一部分专注课业的同学，围坐在一起低头研讨难解的习题，笔尖轻划纸面，偶尔低头演算、偶尔轻声交流思路，眉眼间满是认真专注的模样。
所有人都毫无防备，全然沉浸在这份普通又珍贵的校园日常之中，没有人能够预料，短短几分钟之后，这片温柔平和的校园烟火，将会被突如其来的黑暗裂隙、嗜血狰狞的暗影魔物彻底撕碎，这片盛满欢声笑语的教学楼，会瞬间沦为恐惧蔓延、危机四伏的临时战场。
教室前排靠窗的黄金位置，天野凛星安静端坐于此，自成一方沉静温柔的小天地。

少年身着琉光星冕学园高中部制式校服，整套服饰以暖黄、鎏金、奶白三色渐变为主调，配色温润高级，版型利落挺括，完美衬出他清隽挺拔、干净利落的少年身姿。一头极具辨识度的金调渐变黑发柔顺垂落肩头，发丝自上而下由纯粹的鸦青自然晕染成温柔暖金，发色过渡细腻丝滑，毫无突兀感，发尾常年萦绕一层极淡的细碎星芒，唯有晨光直射之时才会悄然显露，低调又精致。额前碎发修剪得规整清爽，恰到好处垂在眉眼之上，不遮眉眼、不显散漫，完美衬出一张干净清俊、线条柔和的少年面容。
他的眼眸是澄澈通透的桃花眼，眼型温润，眼尾微扬，平日里盛满温柔沉静的星光，明亮坚定，干净纯粹，自带一种与同龄少年截然不同的沉稳通透。此刻他正垂眸静阅课本，纤长浓密的黑睫自然垂落，在眼睑下方投下一片浅浅的柔和阴影，彻底掩去眼底深处潜藏的清冷疏离与厚重沉郁，只余下一派温柔安然、沉静内敛的模样。
脖颈间常年佩戴着一条纤细精致的银链，链条贴合脖颈线条，简约不张扬，吊坠是一枚流线型鎏金渐变星刃造型，小巧精致、质感通透，这是永霜天野王族专属的身份印记。平日里吊坠沉寂无光，与普通配饰别无二致，可一旦周遭滋生暗影戾气、黑暗力量靠近，吊坠便会瞬间泛起刺骨冰寒与圣洁金光，警示危险、呼应本源。

上身是挺括平整的定制奶白衬衫，面料细腻亲肤，做工精细，无一丝褶皱凌乱，领口系着一枚金调丝绒渐变领结，质地顺滑软糯，光泽温润细腻，系得端正规整。衬衫左胸校徽侧边，隐刻着一枚极细的三足鸟暗纹，纹路繁复精致、纤细隐秘，是永霜天野家族传承千年的专属族徽，唯有光线斜切而过之时，方能窥见一丝纹路轮廓，暗藏王族隐秘身份。外搭一件暖黄渐变修身小西装，肩线利落挺拔，剪裁贴合身形，不紧绷、不宽松，自带端正沉稳的气场，袖口处由暖黄自然过渡为鎏金，边缘缀着一圈细闪银线，晨光洒落之时，会流转出细碎精致的微光，细节处尽显王族与生俱来的雅致矜贵。
身姿挺拔端正，脊背永远笔直舒展，静坐之时亦自带规整自律的气质，无半分少年人的散漫慵懒。下身搭配金调渐变修身西裤，裤型利落垂顺，裤身布满细腻的冰棱纹路与星芒暗纹，低调高级，暗藏冰系本源力量的呼应纹路。搭配纯白渐变中筒袜，袜口镶着纤细银边，干净简约；脚上是金冰拼接圆头小皮鞋，鞋侧镶嵌一枚冰色翡翠水滴扣，玉石温润通透，中和了金属的冷冽质感，温润雅致、质感绝佳。
他周身常年萦绕着一缕清冽干净的松雪冷香，气息清淡疏离，沉稳安宁，自带生人勿近的温柔距离感。周遭喧闹的笑语似乎都无法侵染他的方寸天地，让他在热闹的教室里显得格外沉静独特，却又完美融入这片青春烟火，温柔得不突兀。
作为高二（1）班的班长，天野凛星是整个年级乃至全校公认的标杆人物。课业成绩常年稳居年级断层第一，文理全科均衡顶尖，复杂晦涩的数理难题、需要海量积累的文科知识点，他总能快速吃透、精准掌握，解题思路清晰缜密，答案严谨规范，每一次考试榜单，他的名字都稳稳霸占榜首，却从未有半分骄傲张扬、恃才傲物。
行事周全稳妥、待人谦和有礼、处事冷静克制，是所有老师最信任、最省心的得力班委，也是所有同学最依赖、最敬重的班长。班级大小事务，从日常考勤、卫生规整、纪律维护，到校运会、文艺汇演、学科竞赛等各类校园活动的统筹组织、人员调配、细节落实，再到同学之间的矛盾调解、课业答疑帮扶，他全部打理得井井有条、面面俱到，周全妥帖、无可挑剔。
他平日里言语不多，不爱扎堆喧闹、不爱嬉闹张扬，性格内敛温柔，却绝非冷漠孤僻。无论哪位同学前来请教难题、寻求帮助，他永远耐心细致、温柔以待，一视同仁、分寸得体，不刻意热络、不刻意疏离，温柔又有原则，沉稳又有温度，在全班上下拥有极高的威望与人缘。
只是，无人知晓，这位温柔可靠、干净普通的少年班长，皮囊之下藏着足以颠覆整个星界与人界格局的沉重宿命与惊天秘密。
天野凛星，本名炽，是人界极北永霜冰川天野王族唯一正统继承者，身负世间最稀缺、最强大的冰与圣光双生本源，是星界六大王族之中，天命守护天启星核、制衡黑暗暗蚀势力的天选守护者。
三年之前，暗樱女王挣脱星界古老封印，携无边暗影大军、万千暗蚀魔物悍然出世，打破星界千万年的平和秩序。曾经缔结盟约、共同守护星界与人界平衡的六大王族阵营轰然崩塌，暗影浩劫席卷整片星界天地。永霜冰川覆灭、星核祭坛震颤、王族城池崩塌、族人将士喋血沙场，漫天硝烟笼罩星河，无尽哀嚎响彻天地。年少的他亲眼见证家园倾覆、族人陨落、盟约破碎、星河蒙尘，亲历了最绝望、最惨烈的灭族浩劫。
浩劫落幕之际，残存的时珩王族先祖，为保全六位天命王族继承者的性命，为留存星界最后的守护火种，不惜燃烧自身全部灵力、透支千年寿元，催动禁忌时空封印秘术，彻底封存了六位继承者关于王族、浩劫、宿命、使命的所有记忆，隐匿了所有人的本源灵力、王族气息与天赋力量，将六位身负天命的少年少女，全部送入人界琉光星冕学园蛰伏成长。
三年光阴转瞬即逝，他以“天野凛星”这个普通人类身份，安稳度过了三年平凡的校园时光。被深度封印的记忆、力量、宿命全部沉寂于灵魂最深处，唯有刻入血脉、融入灵魂的守护本能、极致警惕与隐忍沉稳，从未被封印抹去，成为他与生俱来的本能特质。
他比所有同龄人都更加成熟内敛、克制坚韧，习惯独自承压、独自消化所有心绪，从不轻易流露脆弱，从不主动倾诉心事，永远以沉稳可靠、无坚不摧的模样，温柔守护着身边的每一个人。
“凛星班长，能不能麻烦你一下？”
一道腼腆温柔、略带局促的男声轻轻响起，温柔打破了窗边的静谧。
天野凛星缓缓抬眸，原本垂落的长睫轻轻掀起，眼底沉淀的清冷疏离尽数褪去，取而代之的是温柔平和的细碎柔光，眼神干净温和，语气清冽悦耳、不急不缓：“怎么了？”
站在他课桌旁的是同班男同学佐藤，性格内向腼腆，不善言辞，成绩中等，面对难题常常无从下手。此刻他双手紧紧攥着一本物理课本，指尖微微泛白，脸上带着几分不好意思的局促神色，小心翼翼将课本推到天野凛星面前，指着页面上一道复杂的复合受力分析大题。
“这道题我绕了好久，受力拆解、公式套用全都理不清逻辑，试了三种解题方法全部算错，死活找不到问题在哪。马上就要早读了，耽误你一点点时间，能不能麻烦你帮我讲一遍解题思路？真的不好意思。”
“没关系。”天野凛星微微颔首，语气温柔淡然，没有半分不耐与敷衍。
他目光专注地落在题干之上，视线快速扫过通篇条件，指尖纤细干净，轻轻点过题干的关键已知条件、隐藏限定要素，条理清晰、层层递进地开始拆解整道大题。从基础受力分析原理、重力弹力摩擦力的方向判定，到复合场景的力的分解合成技巧、公式精准套用、步骤推演逻辑，每一个知识点都讲解得细致通俗、清晰透彻。
围在周边的几名同样卡壳的同学见状，纷纷轻轻靠拢过来，安静聆听、认真记录。有人中途提出疑问、纠结细节误区，天野凛星全部耐心回应、细致拆解，逐一扫清所有人的知识盲区，直到在场所有人全部豁然开朗、彻底吃透解题逻辑，他才轻轻合上课本，重新回归安静坐姿，眼底温柔褪去，再次归于沉静安然。
教室中部靠窗的位置，藤咲若织安静端坐，眉眼温柔，气质温婉，自成一派治愈安稳的氛围。

她同样身着学园制式校服，配色却是适配女生的浅红、柔赤、奶白渐变，温柔明媚、雅致脱俗，与天野凛星的清冷沉稳形成绝佳互补，温柔又有力量。一头标志性的红调渐变长卷发柔顺披落肩头，发丝自上而下由深红温柔晕染成柔赤暖调，发色细腻高级，发尾常年萦绕一层淡淡的赤焰柔光，温暖明媚却绝不张扬，随风轻落之时，尽显少女的温婉灵动。额前碎发自然随性，轻轻垂落眉眼两侧，衬得一双眼眸澄澈如水、温润明净，眼型柔和圆润，目光淡然平静，自带岁月安稳、与世从容的温柔气场。
脖颈间佩戴着一枚纤细银链吊坠，流线型赤红渐变弓矢造型精致细腻，暗藏红莲王族与圣草王族双重血脉印记，是她收敛自身灵力、隐匿王族身份的媒介，亦是她与生俱来的宿命凭证。
上身挺括奶白定制衬衫，领口系着红调丝绒渐变领结，温柔雅致；胸前校徽侧边隐刻红莲弓矢暗纹，是水晶城红莲王族的专属族徽。外搭浅红渐变修身小西装，剪裁舒展柔和、线条温润，没有凌厉的棱角，完美贴合少女柔和的身形，袖口柔赤渐变过渡，缀着细碎银线微光，温柔灵动。
下身搭配同色系红调渐变百褶裙，裙摆规整、长度及膝，裙身布满星羽与弓矢交织的细腻暗纹，雅致内敛、低调高级，走动间裙摆轻轻摇曳，灵动温柔。淡红渐变中筒袜袜口镶细银线条，干净精致；红调拼接圆头小皮鞋鞋侧嵌着通透风色水晶水滴扣，草木清风气息萦绕周身，让她整个人自带干净治愈、温柔亲近的气场。
身为高二（1）班副班长，同时兼任高中部学生会会长，藤咲若织是全校公认的温柔标杆。容貌清丽温婉、性格细腻柔软、心性善良通透、做事沉稳果决。她天生体恤他人、共情力极强，骨子里刻着深入血脉的守护善意，见不得旁人委屈受伤、见不得众生深陷苦难。
班级繁杂事务、学生会层层工作，她全部梳理得井然有序、统筹得当，繁琐枯燥的事务从未有过半句抱怨，始终温柔耐心、细致周全。待人亲和温柔、谦逊有礼，对师长恭敬懂事，对同学温柔包容，遇事冷静沉稳、处事分寸得当，是所有师生心中最温柔、最靠谱、最值得信赖的“小太阳”。
她与天野凛星，仅仅是同班班委、默契搭档、分寸得体的普通同窗。
日常班会协作、班级事务对接、校园工作配合，二人永远默契十足、各司其职、互相配合、彼此尊重。碰面礼貌颔首、相见分寸得当，知晓彼此的性格、能力与人品，是并肩打理班级、维护秩序的可靠搭档，却仅此而已。没有宿命初见的悸动、没有莫名滋生的羁绊、没有逾矩的亲近，始终保持着同窗之间最恰到好处、最干净纯粹的距离，安静共处、各自沉淀。

The golden morning light penetrated the thin clouds, poured down gently, and completely covered the entire Glazed Star Crown Comprehensive Academy.
This top comprehensive university, standing in the bustling hinterland of the human world, has always been more than just an ordinary campus that carries the youthful course work of thousands of students. It is a holy stronghold hidden in the depths of the human world. It is a shelter for the six royal families of the star realm who are dormant in the human world. It is the last barrier of the human world that seals the remnants of the catastrophe and isolates the erosion of shadows. The architectural layout of the entire academy inherits the ancient and elegant style of the star world, and integrates the neat atmosphere of a modern school. The buildings are arranged in a staggered manner. The milky white gilt gradient stone walls are flowing with fine starburst patterns in the morning light. Those hidden in the bricks The ancient protective seals on the stone gaps and corridor walls have accumulated over hundreds of years and are silent on weekdays. Only when the dim light falls in the morning and dusk will they quietly light up with a faint holy halo, silently guarding the tranquility of the entire school.
The main road of the academy is wide and straight, extending straight into the depths of the campus. On both sides of the road are neat rows of star-patterned sycamore trees that belong exclusively to Star Mian Academy. This is a rare spiritual tree that can only survive when nourished by the spiritual energy of the astral world. The tall and straight trunk is clean and straight, and the edges of the layers of emerald green branches and leaves are surrounded by a faint golden shimmer. The morning breeze blows by, and the branches and leaves are swaying gently. The rustling sound is gentle and long, and the scattered light and shadow are scattered all over the ground. The birds perching in the forest flutter their wings and chirp softly, and their crisp and melodious cries penetrate the mist, blending with the sound of turning pages in the teaching building, the brisk chatter and laughter of boys and girls, and the sporadic footsteps in the distance on the playground, outlining the most vivid, stable and healing daily scene of the youth campus.
The air is moist and fresh, carrying the fragrance of vegetation and the cool morning breeze, flowing through every corner of the campus and gently blowing through every open window. The fireworks in the world are gentle and the years are quiet. Everyone is immersed in this stable daily life. No one knows that a dark catastrophe that can tear apart all peace and subvert the order of the entire campus is quietly awakening from the depths of the forbidden forest at the back of the academy and approaching step by step.
The morning reading preparation bell has not yet rang, but the classroom of Class 1, Grade 2, is already warm and packed.
As a key benchmark class in the school, Class 1 of Grade 2 is located on the east side of the third floor of the teaching building, with excellent lighting. The transparent floor-to-ceiling windows are all open. The morning breeze carries the smell of outdoor vegetation and flows into the classroom, stirring the textbook pages laid out on the desk and gently blowing the soft hair on the foreheads of young girls, adding vitality to the clean and bright classroom. The windows in the classroom are bright and clean, the floor is spotless, the tables and chairs are neatly arranged, every tabletop is neatly tidied, and the textbooks, teaching aids, notebooks, and pencil cases are placed in an orderly manner, which is neat and healing. The blackboard has been wiped clean and translucent, and the green potted plants in the corners have lush branches and leaves. The fine greenery is dotted throughout the classroom, which gently dilutes the tightness of the schoolwork and makes the whole classroom relaxed and warm.
The classroom atmosphere at this moment is relaxed and lively, without the tension of morning reading or the noise of recess. The students gathered in small, loose groups in twos and threes, chatting in low voices about their daily fun stories on the weekends. Some shared the taste of new products from street dessert shops, some talked about popular TV series and anime, and some complained about the mountain of weekend homework. Teenagers and girls were brisk and warm. The soft laughter is intertwined, fresh and healing; there are also some students who are focused on their studies, sitting together with their heads down to study difficult exercises, the tip of their pen lightly scratching the paper, occasionally lowering their heads to calculate, occasionally whispering to exchange ideas, their eyebrows are full of serious concentration.
Everyone was unprepared and completely immersed in this ordinary and precious campus daily life. No one could predict that in just a few minutes, this gentle and peaceful campus fireworks would be completely torn apart by sudden dark cracks and bloodthirsty and ferocious shadow monsters. This teaching building full of laughter and laughter would instantly become a temporary battlefield filled with fear and danger.
In the prime position by the window in the front row of the classroom, Amano Rinxei sits quietly here, creating a quiet and gentle little world of its own.
The boy is wearing the regular school uniform of the high school of Ryuguang Xingmian Academy. The whole outfit is mainly composed of three gradient colors: warm yellow, gilt, and milky white. The color is warm and high-end, and the shape is neat and straight, which perfectly accentuates his tall, clean and neat young figure. A head of highly recognizable golden-toned black hair that flows smoothly down her shoulders. The hair is naturally dyed from pure crow green to gentle and warm gold from top to bottom. The hair color transition is delicate and silky, without any sense of abruptness. There is a very light layer of starlight lingering at the end of the hair all the year round. It will only be quietly revealed when the morning light shines directly. It is low-key and exquisite. The broken hair in front of the forehead is trimmed neatly and neatly, hanging just above the eyebrows and eyes, not covering the eyebrows and eyes, not appearing undisciplined, and perfectly setting off a clean, handsome young face with soft lines.
His eyes are clear and transparent peach blossom eyes, with a gentle shape and slightly raised ends. They are usually full of gentle and calm starlight, bright and firm, clean and pure, with a calmness and transparency that is completely different from that of teenagers of the same age. At this moment, he was reading the textbook quietly with his eyes lowered. His long and thick black eyelashes drooped naturally, casting a shallow soft shadow under his eyelids, completely covering up the coldness, alienation and heavy depression hidden deep in his eyes, leaving only a gentle, peaceful, calm and restrained appearance.
A slender and delicate silver chain is worn around the neck all year round. The chain fits the line of the neck, is simple and unobtrusive, and the pendant is a streamlined gilt gradient star blade shape, small and exquisite, with a transparent texture. This is the exclusive identity mark of the Yongshuang Amano royal family. On weekdays, the pendant is silent and dull, just like an ordinary accessory. However, once shadows and evil arise in the surroundings and dark forces approach, the pendant will instantly glow with biting cold and holy golden light, warning of danger and echoing its origin.
The upper body is a crisp and smooth custom-made milk white shirt. The fabric is delicate and skin-friendly, and the workmanship is fine. There is no wrinkle or mess. The collar is tied with a gold-toned velvet gradient bow tie. The texture is smooth and soft, the luster is warm and delicate, and it is tied neatly. On the side of the school emblem on the left chest of the shirt, there is an extremely fine dark pattern of a three-legged bird engraved. The pattern is complex, delicate, slender and secret. It is the exclusive emblem of the Nagashuang Amano family that has been passed down for thousands of years. Only when the light is passing diagonally can one see the outline of the pattern, hiding the secret identity of the royal family. Wear a slim-fitting suit with a warm yellow gradient. The shoulder line is neat and straight, and it is cut to fit the body shape. It is not tight or loose, and it has an upright and steady aura. The cuffs naturally transition from warm yellow to gilt, and are decorated with a circle of fine shining silver lines on the edge. When the morning light falls, a fine and delicate shimmer will flow. The details show the innate elegance and nobility of the royal family.
The posture is upright and upright, the back is always straight and stretched, and he has a neat and self-disciplined temperament when sitting quietly, without any trace of the laziness of a young man. The lower body is paired with slim-fitting trousers with gradient gold tones. The trousers have a neat and smooth shape. The trousers are covered with delicate ice rib textures and starburst dark patterns. They are low-key and high-end, and the textures echo the original power of the ice system. Paired with pure white gradient mid-calf socks, the socks are inlaid with slender silver edges, which is clean and simple; on the feet are gold ice spliced ​​round-toe small leather shoes, with an ice-colored jade drop buckle inlaid on the side of the shoes. The jade is warm and transparent, neutralizing the cold texture of metal, making it warm, elegant and of excellent texture.
There is a clear and clean cold fragrance of pine snow lingering around him all year round. His breath is light and distant, calm and peaceful, with a gentle sense of distance that prevents strangers from getting too close. The noisy laughter around him seems to be unable to invade his small world, making him appear particularly calm and unique in the lively classroom, but he perfectly blends into the youthful fireworks, so gentle that he is not obtrusive.
As the monitor of Class 1, Grade 2, Amano Rinxei is recognized as a role model for the entire grade and even the entire school. His academic performance has always been ranked first in his grade level, and he is at the top of the list in all liberal arts and science subjects. He can always quickly understand and accurately grasp complex and obscure mathematical problems and liberal arts knowledge points that require a large amount of accumulation. His problem-solving ideas are clear and meticulous, and his answers are rigorous and standardized. In every exam list, his name is firmly at the top of the list, but he has never been arrogant or arrogant.
He acts thoughtfully and steadily, treats others with humility and courtesy, and is calm and restrained in dealing with things. He is the most trustworthy and worry-free class committee member of all teachers, and the most dependent and respected monitor of all students. He takes care of everything in the class, from daily attendance, hygiene and discipline maintenance, to the overall organization, personnel allocation, and implementation of details of various campus activities such as school sports meets, art performances, subject competitions, to the mediation of conflicts between classmates, and assistance with homework questions and answers. He takes care of everything in an orderly, comprehensive, and impeccable manner.
He doesn't talk much on weekdays, doesn't like to get together, make noise, or be playful and public. His personality is introverted and gentle, but he is by no means cold and withdrawn. No matter which classmate comes to ask questions or seek help, he is always patient, meticulous, gentle, treats everyone equally and appropriately, neither deliberately warm nor deliberately alienated. He is gentle and principled, calm and warm, and has extremely high prestige and popularity among the whole class.
However, no one knows that this gentle, reliable, clean and ordinary young monitor hides a heavy fate and shocking secret that can subvert the entire structure of the star world and the human world.
Amano Rinsei, whose real name is Chi, is the only orthodox successor of the Amano royal family of the Everfrost Glacier in the far north of the human world. He is responsible for the rarest and most powerful twin origins of ice and holy light in the world. He is among the six royal families in the star world, and is the chosen guardian who is destined to guard the core of the Apocalypse Star and check the forces of darkness and eclipse.
Three years ago, the Queen of Dark Sakura broke free from the ancient seal of the star world and emerged with a boundless shadow army and thousands of necrotic monsters, breaking the peaceful order of the star world for thousands of years. The six royal camps that had formed an alliance to jointly protect the balance between the star world and the human world suddenly collapsed, and the shadow catastrophe swept the entire star world. The Yongshuang Glacier collapsed, the Star Core Altar trembled, the royal city collapsed, the tribesmen and soldiers shed blood on the battlefield, the sky filled with gunpowder smoke enveloped the stars, and endless wails resounded throughout the world. As a young man, he witnessed the overthrow of his homeland, the demise of his tribe, the shattering of alliances, and the dust on the galaxy. He also experienced the most desperate and tragic catastrophe of genocide.
At the end of the catastrophe, the remaining ancestors of the Shiheng royal family, in order to save the lives of the six successors of the Destiny royal family, and to retain the last guardian fire of the star world, they did not hesitate to burn all their spiritual power, overdraw their thousand-year lifespan, and activate the forbidden time and space sealing secret technique to completely seal the world. All the memories of the six heirs about the royal family, catastrophe, fate, and mission were saved, and everyone's original spiritual power, royal aura, and natural power were hidden, and all six young girls with destiny were sent to the human world to hibernate and grow up in the Glazed Star Mian Academy.
Three years passed in a blink of an eye. As an ordinary human being named "Amano Rinxei", ​​he spent three years of ordinary school time peacefully. The deeply sealed memory, power, and destiny were all silent in the deepest part of his soul. Only the protective instinct, extreme vigilance, and forbearance and calmness that were engraved in his blood and integrated into his soul were never erased by the seal and became his innate instinctive traits.
He is more mature, reserved, restrained and tenacious than all his peers. He is used to bearing pressure and digesting all his emotions alone. He never shows vulnerability easily or takes the initiative to talk about his feelings. He always protects everyone around him with a calm, reliable and indestructible appearance.
"Squad leader Linxing, can I trouble you?"
A shy, gentle, slightly awkward male voice sounded softly, breaking the silence by the window.
Amano Rinxing slowly raised his eyes, and his long eyelashes that were originally drooping were gently lifted. The coldness and alienation in his eyes faded away, replaced by soft and gentle light. His eyes were clean and gentle, and his tone was clear, sweet, and unhurried: "What's wrong?"
Standing next to his desk is his male classmate Sato. He is introverted and shy, not good at words, has average grades, and often has no idea what to do when faced with difficult problems. At this moment, he was holding a physics textbook tightly in his hands, his fingertips were slightly white, and he had a somewhat embarrassed look on his face. He carefully pushed the textbook in front of Amano Rinxing and pointed to a complex compound force analysis question on the page.
"I have been wandering around this question for a long time. I can't figure out the logic of force disassembly and formula application. I have tried three ways to solve the problem and all calculations are wrong. I can't find the problem. I am about to read it early. I wasted a little time on you. Could you please help me explain the solution to the problem? I'm really sorry."
"It's okay." Amano Rinxing nodded slightly, his tone gentle and indifferent, without any hint of impatience or perfunctoryness.
His eyes focused on the question stem, and his eyes quickly scanned the conditions throughout the article. His fingertips were slender and clean, and he gently clicked on the key known conditions and hidden limiting elements of the question stem, and began to dismantle the entire big question in a clear and step-by-step manner. From basic force analysis principles, determination of the direction of gravity, elasticity and friction, to force decomposition and synthesis techniques in composite scenes, accurate application of formulas, and step-by-step deduction logic, every knowledge point is explained in a detailed, popular, clear and thorough manner.
Seeing this, several students who were also stuck around gathered around and gently came over to listen quietly and record carefully. Someone raised questions midway and struggled with misunderstandings about details. Amano Rinkei patiently responded to them all, carefully dismantled them, and cleared everyone's knowledge blind spots one by one. It was not until everyone present suddenly understood and thoroughly understood the logic of problem-solving that he gently closed the textbook and returned to a quiet sitting posture. The gentleness in his eyes faded, and he became calm and peaceful again.
In the middle of the classroom, by the window, Fujisaki Wakaori sits quietly and upright, with gentle eyebrows and gentle temperament, creating a healing and stable atmosphere of its own.
She is also wearing the school uniform, but the color scheme is suitable for girls with a gradient of light red, soft red, and milky white. She is gentle, bright, elegant and refined, which perfectly complements Amano Rinboshi's coolness and calmness, and is gentle and powerful. Her iconic red-toned long curly hair cascades smoothly over her shoulders. The hair is gently dyed from deep red to soft red warm tone from top to bottom. The hair color is exquisite and advanced. There is a faint layer of red flame lingering at the end of the hair all year round. It is warm and bright but never ostentatious. When it falls gently in the wind, it shows the gentleness and agility of a girl. The broken hair on the forehead is natural and casual, and gently falls on the sides of the eyebrows and eyes, setting off a pair of eyes as clear as water, warm and bright, with a soft and round eye shape, a calm and calm look, and a gentle aura of being stable and calm with the world.
Wearing a slender silver chain pendant around her neck, the streamlined red gradient bow and arrow are exquisitely shaped, hiding the dual bloodline marks of the Red Lotus Royal Family and the Holy Grass Royal Family. It is a medium for her to condense her spiritual power and hide her royal identity. It is also the proof of her innate destiny.
The upper body is a crisp cream-white custom-made shirt, and the collar is tied with a red velvet gradient bow tie, which is gentle and elegant; the school emblem on the chest is engraved with a red lotus bow and arrow hidden pattern on the side, which is the exclusive emblem of the Red Lotus royal family of Crystal City. Wear a light red gradient slim-fitting suit with a soft cut, gentle lines, and no sharp edges. It perfectly fits the girl's soft figure. The cuffs have a soft red gradient transition and are embellished with fine silver thread shimmer, making it gentle and smart.
The lower body is paired with a red-toned gradient pleated skirt of the same color. The skirt has a regular hem and is knee-length. The skirt is covered with delicate dark patterns intertwined with star feathers and bows and arrows. It is elegant, restrained, low-key and high-end. The skirt sways gently when walking, making it smart and gentle. The pale red gradient mid-calf socks are inlaid with thin silver lines, which are clean and delicate; the red-toned spliced ​​round-toe small leather shoes are embedded with air-colored crystal water drop buckles on the sides. The breeze of grass and trees lingers around her, giving her a clean, healing, gentle and close aura.
As the vice president of class 1 of the second grade of high school and concurrently as the president of the high school student union, Fujisaki Wakaori is recognized by the whole school as a model of gentleness. She has a beautiful and gentle appearance, a delicate and soft personality, a kind and transparent heart, and is calm and decisive in doing things. She is naturally considerate of others and has a strong sense of empathy. She has a protective kindness that runs deep in her blood. She does not want to see others being wronged or hurt, nor does she want to see all sentient beings in deep misery.
She kept all the complicated affairs of the class and the work of the student union in an orderly and well-coordinated manner. She never complained about the tedious affairs and was always gentle, patient, and meticulous. He is kind, gentle, humble and polite to others, respectful and sensible to his teachers, gentle and tolerant to his classmates, calm and steady when dealing with things, and handled appropriately. He is the gentlest, most reliable and most trustworthy "little sun" in the hearts of all teachers and students.
She and Amano Rinsei are just ordinary classmates who are in the same class, have a tacit understanding of each other, and are decent classmates.
In daily class meetings, class affairs, and campus work, the two always have a tacit understanding, perform their duties, cooperate with each other, and respect each other. They nod politely when meeting each other, meet each other appropriately, and understand each other's character, ability and character. They are reliable partners who run the class side by side and maintain order, but that's all. There is no throbbing of fateful first meeting, no inexplicable bonds, and no excessive closeness. We always maintain the most appropriate, pure and pure distance between classmates, coexisting peacefully and settling down separately.
